rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a poison antidote and for something that counteracts a harmful situation, especially figuratively.

example.english: A few comforting words from a friend were an antidote to the whole evening.
example.traditional: 朋友一句安慰說話，真係成個夜晚嘅解藥。
example.jyutping: pang4 jau5 jat1 geoi3 on1 wai3 syut3 waa6 zan1 hai6 seng4 go3 je6 maan5 ge3 gaai2 joek6

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean medicine that neutralizes poison, rather than a figurative countermeasure.

example.english: The doctor said this pill was an antidote to snake venom.
example.traditional: 醫生話呢粒係蛇毒嘅解毒藥。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 ni1 lap1 hai6 se4 duk6 ge3 gaai2 duk6 joek6
